create_get_project_name: get the GCP Project ID using the get_project_name function
create_get_project_number: get the GCP Project Number using the get_project_number function
create_get_creds: get Google credentials for GCP APIs using the get_creds function
create_enable_apis: enable required GCP APIs on the project using the enable_apis function
create_get_service_account: get or create a GCP service account with IAM permissions using the get_service_account function
